Blade
Rush

Knock each bandit into the sea as it reaches the gold line. Miss, and it hits you. Lose all 5 hearts and the run ends.

Mobile: swipe across a bandit. Twin bandits come tied together, so one wide swipe knocks out both.

PC: press ← for the left lanes and → for the right lanes. Press both for twins. Esc pauses.

Level 1: Harbour Town, 118 BPM.
